name: Goa, Gokarna and the Karnataka coast
one_line: Goa and Karnataka, down the west coast from Panaji to Mangaluru

source.title: National Highway 66 (India)

fuel.note: Pumps are those drawn on the open map within the search radius of the road. A pump missing from the map is missing here, so each gap is a worst case.

rules.title: Goa: helmet compulsory for rider and pillion
rules.detail: Both people on a two-wheeler must wear a helmet. The Chief Minister told the assembly in January 2026 that the Transport Department has issued a circular.
rules.applies_to: All two-wheeler riders and pillion riders
rules.set_by: Directorate of Transport, Government of Goa, and Goa Traffic Police

source.title: Helmets Mandatory for Rider and Pillion: CM

history.change: Traffic police circular made certified helmets compulsory for riders and pillion riders, with both liable to prosecution.

source.title: Helmets made mandatory for two-wheeler riders in Goa

history.change: Chief Minister told the assembly that a Transport Department circular makes helmets mandatory for rider and pillion.

source.title: Helmets Mandatory for Rider and Pillion: CM

rules.title: Goa: rented motorcycles run under a licensed scheme
rules.detail: Hire motorcycles are licensed under the Rent a Motorcycle Scheme, 1997, and the renter signs an undertaking. The Transport Department lists the orders and the form.
rules.applies_to: Anyone renting a motorcycle in Goa
rules.set_by: State Transport Authority and Directorate of Transport, Government of Goa

source.title: Notification, Department of Transport, Government of Goa

history.change: State Transport Authority order set the procedure to renew, replace, transfer and add vehicles on a rent a motorcycle licence.

source.title: Notification, Department of Transport, Government of Goa

history.change: State Transport Authority order on transfer of a rent a motorcycle licence.

source.title: Notification, Department of Transport, Government of Goa

rules.title: Goa: check a hire vehicle's permit online
rules.detail: The Transport Department site has a lookup that takes a Goa registration number and shows whether the vehicle holds a permit.
rules.applies_to: Anyone renting a vehicle in Goa
rules.set_by: Directorate of Transport, Government of Goa

source.title: Know Vehicle Permit, Department of Transport, Government of Goa

rules.title: Goa: hiring a privately registered two-wheeler is illegal
rules.detail: Only vehicles registered for hire may be rented. The government said in 2022 that owners renting out private vehicles face penalties and possible licence suspension.
rules.applies_to: Anyone renting a two-wheeler in Goa
rules.set_by: Directorate of Transport, Government of Goa

source.title: Govt pulls brakes on those hiring private vehicles

history.change: Government announced action against private vehicles rented to tourists; the Transport Minister said hire operators would have to supply certified helmets.

source.title: Govt pulls brakes on those hiring private vehicles

rules.title: Goa hire motorcycles usually may not leave the state
rules.detail: A rental company says many hire vehicles are tracked and fenced to stop them crossing the state border. This is a rental term; no government order was found.
rules.applies_to: Anyone renting a motorcycle in Goa

source.title: Bike and Car Renting Laws in Goa

rules.title: Goa: no riding on beaches
rules.detail: Driving any vehicle on a beach is an offence. Beaches are open from 7 am to sunset. Carry your licence while riding.
rules.set_by: Department of Tourism, Government of Goa

source.title: Do and Don'ts Advice / Instruction to tourists by Tourism Department

rules.title: Uttara Kannada: monsoon ban on waterfalls and danger spots
rules.detail: In July 2026 the district administration barred tourists from dangerous areas and from bathing in waterfalls, including those beside the highway near Karwar and Ankola.

source.title: Uttara Kannada Monsoon Alert: Tourists Risk Lives at Temporary Waterfalls Amid Landslide Warnings

season.note: No sourced best months were found; June to August is the wettest stretch, with more than 600 millimetres of rain a month at Gokarna.

hazards.title: Landslides on the highway in Uttara Kannada
hazards.detail: A landslide at Shirur near Ankola on 16 July 2024 buried vehicles and shut the highway. The district has 324 spots marked as prone to landslides.

source.title: Karnataka: Death toll in NH 66 landslide reached 6

hazards.title: Parked vehicles at roadside waterfalls
hazards.detail: In the rains, waterfalls form on the rock cuttings of the widened highway near Karwar and Ankola, and visitors stop their vehicles on the carriageway.

source.title: Uttara Kannada Monsoon Alert: Tourists Risk Lives at Temporary Waterfalls Amid Landslide Warnings

hazards.title: Very heavy monsoon rain and high waves
hazards.detail: The monsoon reached coastal Karnataka in late May in 2025, with a red alert, fallen trees and flooding. June to August are the wettest months.

source.title: Southwest Monsoon hits Karnataka; red alert in coastal areas

gaps: Entry tax for vehicles from other states: an undated Deccan Herald report (https://www.deccanherald.com/india/karnataka/goa-hikes-entry-tax-for-vehicles-313796.html) lists charges from three-wheelers upward at Goa's border posts. The page could not be opened and no official page was found, so whether two-wheelers pay is not recorded.
The text of the Goa helmet circular was not found on the Transport Department site; only press reports were read.
The Goa Transport Department's list of rent a bike notifications could not be opened; only the titles on the main notifications page were read.
Best months and usual number of riding days: no source found.
No highest point recorded: this is a coastal route.
No source found for rules on hire motorcycles or helmets specific to coastal Karnataka.
The Press Information Bureau release on the 2024 Shirur landslide returned an access error.
Videos: the pages give upload dates, not filming dates, so 'filmed' is filled only where the title names a date. Uploads, in order: 2025-12, 2022-02.
